caseName: United Mine Workers, Local No. 1854 v. National Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: United Mine Workers of America, Local No. 1854 v. National Labor Relations Board and National Labor Relations Board v. Amax Coal Co., a division of Amax, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Certiorari in No. 80-289 granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition. Certiorari in No. 80-692 granted. Cases consolidated and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 6.14 F. 2d 872.
